_note: All entries here are seeded fresh by cypress/support/db-tasks.js#seedFixtures. Usernames use a 'cypress_' prefix on purpose: this dev database is shared/persistent and already has real users named 'therapist1'/'parent1' etc. with different passwords, so a plain, unprefixed username silently collides via INSERT IGNORE and login fails against the wrong (pre-existing) row. Do not remove the prefix without also guaranteeing no pre-existing row can ever share the name.

therapist2.note: Disjoint roster from therapist1 — used for cross-tenant RBAC checks.
